# SFTP Receiver

This receiver periodically pulls text files from an SFTP server and emits one log record per line.

Every pull connects to the server and reads what was appended to the matching
files since the previous pull.

Each record carries the line as its body and the remote path in the
`log.file.path` attribute. Use processors such as `transform` to parse the body.

## Configuration

| Field               | Default | Description                                                                                   |
|---------------------|---------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `endpoint`          |         | Required. `host:port` of the SFTP server.                                                     |
| `username`          |         | Required.                                                                                     |
| `password`          |         | Password of the user, or the passphrase of `key_file` when both are set.                      |
| `key_file`          |         | Path to a private key. `password` or `key_file` is required.                                  |
| `known_hosts`       |         | Path to a `known_hosts` file that verifies the server. Required unless `ignore_host_key`.     |
| `ignore_host_key`   | `false` | Skips server verification. For testing only.                                                  |
| `include`           |         | Required. Globs of remote files, in [`path.Match`](https://pkg.go.dev/path#Match) syntax.     |
| `poll_interval`     | `1m`    | Time between two pulls.                                                                       |
| `storage`           |         | ID of a storage extension that keeps the read offsets across restarts.                        |

Create `known_hosts` with `ssh-keyscan -p <port> <host>`.

```yaml
extensions:
  file_storage:
    directory: /var/lib/otelcol/storage

receivers:
  sftp:
    endpoint: sftp.example.com:22
    username: collector
    key_file: /etc/otelcol/id_ed25519
    known_hosts: /etc/otelcol/known_hosts
    include:
      - /var/log/app/*.log
    poll_interval: 5m
    storage: file_storage

service:
  extensions: [file_storage]
  pipelines:
    logs:
      receivers: [sftp]
      exporters: [debug]
```

## Delivery

- Reading starts at the beginning of each file. The offset of a file advances
  only after the pipeline accepts the lines, so a refused batch is sent again
  by the next pull. Delivery is at-least-once.
- Without `storage`, a restart reads every file again from the beginning.
- A last line without a trailing newline is emitted once the file has the same
  size in two consecutive pulls.
- Empty lines are skipped. Lines longer than 1 MiB are split.
- A file that shrinks is read again from the beginning. A file replaced by a
  longer one is not detected and is read from the previous offset.
- `**` globs and compressed files are not supported.
